summary.text: Mark Cohen is running on the Nonpartisan ballot line in the Nov. 3, 2026 general election for Nebraska's 3rd District.

paragraphs.text: Lives in Lemoyne, Nebraska; describes himself as a father, veteran, agricultural lawyer, and karate instructor.
A former Air Force judge advocate who first came to Nebraska more than forty years ago, according to Nebraska Rural Radio; he has served as a Special Assistant U.S. Attorney for Nebraska.
Later practiced law in Omaha during the farm crisis of the late 1980s, according to Nebraska Rural Radio.
Says he has been a Nebraska Admiral for 39 years.
Submitted about 3,680 signatures on July 30, 2026 to qualify for the ballot as a nonpartisan candidate; state law requires at least 2,000 valid signatures.
